# What should you reorder this week, and what is just cash on a shelf?

> Free reorder planner for Shopify and other small online stores: load an orders export and a stock export and see each SKU's reorder point, how many to order, revenue at risk from stock-outs and cash tied up in overstock. Runs in your browser, files are never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
